verdict.rationale: The evidence covers hiring pipelines per job, generic templates, and applicant-facing job questions on application forms. None of these documents a per-role interview plan with interview question banks or per-interviewer focus areas. Pipelines and application-form questions are adjacent features, not the structured interview plan this story asks for.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
